status: frozen before learning; no outcome claimed
freeze_confirmation: new architecture trial prospectively frozen before any optimizer update; initializer/shuffle roles and all optimizer/split/quality settings unchanged; prior shared test evaluation acknowledged

initializer.bound: f32(1/sqrt(C*KH*KW)) for convolution, f32(1/sqrt(inputwidth)) for linear
initializer.bias: same uniform initializer and bound as its layer weight

model.layout: NCHW input and activations, OIHW weights; cross-correlation, stride1, no padding/dilation/groups

training.engine: public mdl/autodiff/trainer/AdamW path; Coax owns arithmetic
training.published_row_gradients: binary32 rounded after f64 reverse accumulation
training.loss: SUM over ten one-hot squared errors per row, not mean over classes
training.shuffle_algorithm: descending Fisher-Yates using cr_bits(seed,counter)%(i+1); each epoch continues the previous permutation, counter starts at epoch*(rows-1)

evaluation.validation: initial and at fixed epoch boundaries; no selection or tuning
evaluation.official_test: initial and final only, fixed by this profile; never feeds gradients or selection
evaluation.baseline: constant classifier choosing the most frequent TRAINING label; lowest label on a tie; score on the same official test slice
evaluation.selection: one fixed model; no search, tuning or retries chosen by test results
evaluation.cross_trial_scope: The same2048 official-test slice was observed in the prior residual linear-head trial. Architecture choice is not independent of that evaluation; this is another prospectively frozen comparison, not a pristine unseen final test.

reproduction.resume: replay exactly the next optimizer UPDATE (same16rows) from checkpoint; compare all master parameters, first/second moments, order and cursor bits to the canonical next update; do not rerun six epochs
reproduction.export_reload: final state dictionary reload reproduces predictions on all2048testrows
reproduction.source_binding: before learning, root writes separate freeze record with source closure, config/preprocess/dataset identities, native C/header and binary hashes

prohibited: tuning after validation or test observations
changing sample splits, seeds, epochs or thresholds to obtain a pass
counting tooling math as a product runtime
